items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: And there's him and Johnny there together. So he was very good for the Tom Benton.

ctx.x: Watch. I heard he was piano player.

What was Clarence Williams doing in this group? Did he sing or play piano some time? Well...
